This role will be critical in ensuring our SAP C4C landscape supports strategic business goals, drives efficiency, and enhances customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architectural design, development, and implementation of SAP C4C solutions, encompassing Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud modules.
  • Collaborate extensively with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate complex business requirements into detailed system specifications and functional designs for SAP C4C.
  • Design end-to-end SAP C4C solutions, including configuration, custom development (SDK), UI adaptations, and reporting, ensuring alignment with overall enterprise architecture and best practices.
  • Define and oversee the integration strategy for SAP C4C with other critical systems, including SAP ECC/S/4HANA, SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), SAP PI/PO, and other third-party applications, ensuring seamless data flow and process automation.
  • Provide expert technical guidance, mentorship, and leadership to development and functional teams, ensuring adherence to architectural standards, quality, and performance.
  • Ensure the optimal performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability of SAP C4C solutions. Conduct system analysis, identify bottlenecks, and propose improvements.
  • Define and enforce architecture standards, best practices, and governance frameworks for SAP C4C implementation and ongoing operations.
  • Create comprehensive solution documentation, including architectural blueprints, functional specifications, technical designs, test plans, and deployment strategies.
  • Lead and facilitate workshops, fit-gap analysis, and design sessions with business users and technical teams.
  • Stay abreast of the latest SAP C4C features, product roadmaps, industry trends, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI, predictive analytics within C4C) to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Provide architectural input for project planning, effort estimation, risk assessment, and technical feasibility studies. Support go-live and post-production activities.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of overall SAP experience, with at least 8+ years specifically in SAP C4C.
  • Proven hands-on experience with SAP C4C configuration, extensions (using Cloud Applications Studio/SDK), and integration methodologies (SAP CPI/HCI, PI/PO, Web Services, OData, IDocs).
  • Strong understanding of SAP C4C data model, workflows, business objects, and UI configuration.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing end-to-end SAP C4C solutions for complex business scenarios.
  • Familiarity with various project methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively interact with stakeholders at all levels, from technical teams to senior business leadership.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP C4C Certification(s).
  • Experience with other SAP CX (Customer Experience) solutions
  • Knowledge of ABAP development for integration scenarios with SAP ECC/S/4HANA.
  • Experience on Sales and Service Cloud V2 could be an added advantage.

title: Deputy Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
jobDescription:
Job Summary
To support the PO Lead in execution of App and Web digital product initiatives by managing requirement documentation, stakeholder coordination, UAT execution, defect tracking, release readiness, KPI monitoring and post-live adoption tracking to ensure timely delivery of customer-centric digital journeys and business outcomes.
Responsibilities
  • Requirement gathering and documentation
  • Understand business requirements, customer journey gaps and digital platform enhancement needs from PO Lead and business stakeholders.
  • Prepare BRDs, user stories, process flows, screen-level requirements and acceptance criteria for assigned initiatives.
  • Maintain requirement trackers, dependency logs and version control for all assigned product changes.
  • Coordinate requirement walkthroughs with Technology, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk and Compliance teams.
  • Product delivery and execution support
  • Support PO Lead in delivery of assigned App and Web product features from requirement finalization to go-live.
  • Track project milestones, sprint progress, open dependencies, issue closures and delivery timelines.
  • Coordinate with IT and cross-functional teams to ensure scope clarity, timely clarifications and execution discipline.
  • Highlight risks, deviations and blockers proactively to the PO Lead for governance and escalation.
  • UAT, defect and release governance
  • Prepare UAT scenarios, test cases and validation checkpoints basis approved requirements and journey flows.
  • Coordinate UAT execution with business users and ensure defects are logged, prioritized and tracked to closure.
  • Validate fixes, maintain defect tracker and support go-live readiness sign-off documentation.
  • Support release notes, SOP updates, launch communication and post-deployment validation activities.
  • KPI monitoring and post-live tracking
  • Track post-live performance for assigned journeys including traffic, leads, funnel conversion, drop-offs and feature adoption.
  • Coordinate with Analytics teams for dashboard validation, data accuracy and metric-level insights.
  • Prepare periodic performance updates and share actionable observations with PO Lead.
  • Support improvement backlog creation based on customer behaviour, KPI trends and business feedback.
  • Customer journey and UI/UX coordination
  • Work with DCX/UI-UX teams to review screen flows, wireframes, content and customer communication for assigned journeys.
  • Identify customer friction points and recommend practical journey improvements to improve completion and conversion.
  • Ensure customer experience guidelines and digital design standards are followed during implementation.
  • Stakeholder coordination and governance reporting
  • Coordinate with Business, PMG, IT, Analytics, Design, Operations, Risk and Compliance teams for assigned initiatives.
  • Prepare project status notes, meeting minutes, action trackers, issue logs and governance updates.
  • Ensure timely follow-up and closure of action items across stakeholders.
  • Process discipline and knowledge management
  • Maintain proper documentation repository for requirements, approvals, UAT evidence, release artefacts and dashboards.
  • Support process standardization and continuous improvement within the POD operating rhythm.
Key Decisions / Dimensions
  • Following decisions are taken by the role:
  • Recommendation on UAT test coverage, defect severity and readiness inputs for release sign-off.
  • Recommendation on requirement clarifications, scope observations and execution dependencies to PO Lead.
  • Identification of journey improvement opportunities based on KPI trends, customer feedback and UAT observations.
  • Escalation of unresolved issues, delayed action items and critical defects to PO Lead.
  • Supports digital business outcomes for assigned App and Web journeys through timely execution, KPI tracking, funnel improvement and adoption monitoring.
Major Challenges
  • Capturing clear requirements and managing frequent changes without impacting committed delivery timelines.
  • Coordinating with multiple stakeholders for timely clarifications, UAT support and defect closure.
  • Ensuring quality UAT execution and release readiness across multiple App and Web journeys.
  • Maintaining accurate KPI tracking and providing actionable insights after go-live.
  • Balancing day-to-day execution activities with structured documentation and governance expectations.
Required Qualifications and Experience

Educational Qualifications
  • Graduation in Engineering, Technology, Management, Business or related discipline.
  • Post-Graduation / MBA preferred but not mandatory.
Work Experience
  • Minimum 4 - 8 years of experience for Manager / 6 - 10 years for Sr. Manager in Digital Product, Project Delivery, Business Analysis, UAT or Digital Platforms.
  • Experience in BFSI / FinTech / Digital Lending / Consumer Platforms preferred.
  • Strong understanding of requirement documentation, UAT management, release governance and digital journey monitoring.
  • Ability to coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders and drive action closure within timelines.
Functional Knowledge
  • BRD/user story preparation, process mapping, UAT execution, defect tracking, release readiness, KPI monitoring, dashboard validation, App/Web customer journeys and stakeholder coordination.

At SIXT, AI is changing how work gets done and we are looking for the person who will help us do it safely. HEAD OF DELIVERY

Enterprise AI Solutions

Oriserve (oriserve.com)

Location

Noida, India (office-based, with client travel)

818 years

Reports to

Founders

Direct Reports

Pod Managers, Engagement Managers, and Project Managers


Why This Role Exists

Delivery is where Oriserve's value is realised. Every dollar of recurring revenue flows through client programs that this function owns from post-sale handoff through go-live, steady-state operations, expansion, and renewal.

As we scale, we need a leader who can institutionalise delivery excellence someone who builds a team of client-facing consultants (not project trackers), drives revenue realisation across the portfolio, and ensures every client engagement creates demonstrable business impact.

This person will lead the entire delivery and operations program, set the quality and governance standards, and build the team's capability to independently manage complex enterprise accounts end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities


Revenue Ownership & Commercial Accountability

Own the delivery P&L revenue under management, go-live velocity, expansion revenue, retention, and delivery margins across the full client portfolio.

Drive revenue realisation reduce signing-to-billing timelines, convert POCs into production, expand existing accounts through demonstrated value, and retain clients through proactive relationship management.

Commercial rigour partner with Finance on billing accuracy, collections, and forecasting. Ensure no revenue leaks across the portfolio.


Client Leadership & Business Depth

Be the strategic partner to enterprise clients build executive trust, run business reviews, maintain account roadmaps, and translate client outcomes (containment rates, conversion uplift, collections recovery) into delivery plans.

Drive expansion turn delivered value into new use cases, geographies, and lines of business. Work with Sales to create accurate, delivery-ready scope packages.

Set the communication standard every client touchpoint — from check-ins to quarterly reviews — should reflect consulting-grade quality, rigour, and professionalism.


Delivery Operations & Governance

Build and enforce a delivery lifecycle — from handoff through go-live, hyper-care, steady-state, and renewal — with clear stage gates, accountability, and visibility at every step.

Operating rhythm — establish weekly, monthly, and quarterly review cadences that keep projects on track, surface risks early, and connect delivery performance to revenue outcomes.

Decisive on stalling projects — no project should go invisible or consume resources without a clear path to production and revenue. Build governance that prevents zombie projects.

Infrastructure and cost discipline — ensure every deployment is tracked from Day 1, and decommissioned promptly when a client churns. Zero waste.


Quality & Reliability

Production quality standards — enforce structured post go-live reviews, incident management discipline, and measurable AI quality benchmarks that improve over time.

Documentation and artifact discipline — business reviews backed by data, check-ins documented, every scope change recorded. If it isn't documented, it didn't happen.


People Leadership

Build consultants, not coordinators — coach Pod Managers and PMs on client management, structured problem-solving, commercial thinking, and written communication. Develop business depth across the team.

Structured performance management — clear KRAs per person, quarterly reviews linked to incentives, decisive action on underperformance, and a high hiring bar for new team members.

Scale the team — structure pods by account complexity, define the capability model, and build a bench that grows without diluting quality.


Ideal Candidate Profile


Core Experience

8–18 years — in delivery leadership, program management, or engagement management at a B2B SaaS company, enterprise AI/tech firm, IT services leader, or top-tier consulting firm.

P&L accountability — has directly owned revenue realisation and delivery margins — not just project execution. Understands the difference between "project delivered" and "revenue collected."

Team leadership — has built and managed delivery teams of 8+ people, including Pod Managers or Engagement Managers with their own client portfolios.

Enterprise delivery experience — BFSI or Telecom strongly preferred. Understands the compliance, procurement, and stakeholder complexity of large Indian enterprises.


Problem Solving & Analytics

Structured thinker who converts ambiguity into measurable plans and evidence-based decisions.

Comfortable with financial models, funnel analysis, capacity planning, and operational dashboards.


Communication & Stakeholder Leadership

Outstanding written and verbal communication — sets the quality bar for the entire team.

Earns trust with senior client stakeholders. Can have a business conversation with a CXO, not just a status update.

Fluent in English and Hindi.


Education

Postgraduate or advanced degree from a reputed institution (MBA / Engineering / Analytics or equivalent).


Mindset

Ownership — spots risks and opportunities before they become escalations.

Commercially minded — thinks in revenue, margin, and client lifetime value.

Process builder — creates systems that scale, not just solves individual problems.

Team-first leader — high standards with coaching, not just criticism.


Nice-to-Have

Experience with Conversational AI, voice bots, chatbots, or contact centre automation.

Familiarity with CCaaS, telephony (SIP/dialers), or API-driven integrations.

Experience with AI/ML-powered products in production environments.


What Makes This Role Different


This is not a traditional delivery management role. At Oriserve:

You own the revenue line — delivery and commercial success are the same thing.

Your team's work powers over 1.5 million AI conversations daily for India's leading enterprises. The domain is cutting-edge, the stakes are real.

You will build the delivery function's operating system — standards, governance, incentives, and team capability — from the ground up.

You work directly with the founders on strategy, pricing, and client decisions. This is a leadership seat, not a middle-management role.

Your team uses AI tools daily for analysis, documentation, and decision-making — operating at the frontier of AI-assisted delivery.

tagsAndSkills: Data Modelling,Artificial Intelligence (AI),Data Architect,Machine Learning,Python,Architecture,Artificial Intelligence,Data
jobDescription:
Mandatory Skills Description:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). An advanced degree is a plus but not required.

Experience: Approximately 3-5 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or a related data management role. A proven track record in designing data solutions and managing data schemas is expected.

Data Modelling & Databases: Strong proficiency in data modelling and database design. You should be comfortable creating ER diagrams and defining relational schema, as well as working with NoSQL databases (e.g. document or graph databases). Practical experience with SQL and at least one relational database is required, as well as deep knowledge of other data store types (especially graph databases) is highly needed.

Data Pipeline Development: Hands-on experience developing data pipelines and integration workflows. This includes proficiency in ETL/ELT tools or frameworks (or custom scripting with Python/SQL) to gather and transform data. You should understand how to optimise data flow and have experience with batch processing; experience with real-time streaming data (e.g. using Kafka or equivalent) is a plus.

Ontologies & Knowledge Graphs: Exposure to semantic data modelling, ontologies, or knowledge graph construction. Experience in structuring data with ontologies (e.g. using RDF/OWL standards) or implementing a knowledge graph to link datasets can be very beneficial, since it helps in creating a unified data vocabulary and enriches the context for AI models.

Cloud Data Platforms: Experience working with cloud-based data platforms or big data technologies. While our approach is cloud-agnostic, you should be familiar with concepts like data lakes, data warehouses, and distributed computing in a cloud environment (e.g. using AWS, Azure, or GCP services). The ability to design solutions that leverage cloud scalability and tools for storage and processing is important.

Data Governance & Security: Solid understanding of data governance principles and best practices. You should be knowledgeable about data privacy regulations and data protection techniques, ensuring compliance in how data is stored and used. Experience implementing data quality checks, defining data standards, and using or setting up metadata management tools will be useful.

Communication & Teamwork: Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams. You should be able to translate complex data architecture concepts into clear terms for project managers or stakeholders, and work closely with engineering teams to guide implementation. Problem-solving aptitude and a willingness to mentor junior data team members are also important in our collaborative environment.

title: Senior Product Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Purpose
We are looking for a Senior UI Developer to build a modern, conversational user interface for an enterprise AI platform. This role focuses on creating a clean, minimal, and highly interactive single-page experience where users interact primarily through conversation rather than traditional screens. You will work closely with backend, AI, and SDK teams to translate system responses into intuitive, dynamic UI components. The role involves building complex animations, handling multimodal inputs, ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews, and maintaining high code quality suitable for large-scale production systems.
Duties and Responsibilities
Conversational UI Frontend Development Design and build a single-page, conversational UI that replaces traditional multi-screen flows. Develop dynamic, schema-driven UI components that render based on user intent, profile, and system capabilities. Implement fluid animations, transitions, and motion systems while ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews and browsers. Build support for multimodal inputs and outputs including text, voice, image, and file interactions. Ensure UI adapts gracefully across devices, channels (WebView vs browser), and capability constraints. UI Architecture Code Quality Contribute to frontend architecture decisions, component design, and state management patterns. Build reusable, well-structured UI components with clear separation of concerns. Ensure code is clean, maintainable, and easy for other developers to understand and extend. Work closely with backend teams to consume UI schemas, capability flags, and conversational state. Performance, Security Stability Optimize bundle size, rendering performance, and animation smoothness for low-end devices. Implement fallback and degradation strategies for constrained environments. Follow secure frontend practices including CSP compliance, PII masking, and safe handling of user inputs. Support analytics, audit events, and session tracking hooks as required by enterprise standards. Collaboration Delivery Collaborate with AI, backend, SDK, and product teams to translate conversational responses into effective UI. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and iterative UI improvements. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds and deployments
Key Decisions / Dimensions
UI Design Implementation Decisions Choosing appropriate UI patterns for conversational and single-task interfaces instead of traditional page-based navigation. Deciding when UI behavior should be driven by backend schemas versus handled locally in the frontend. Selecting animation and motion techniques that balance visual richness with performance constraints. Deciding fallback and degradation strategies for low-end devices, WebView limitations, and browser constraints. Framework Component Decisions Defining reusable UI components and interaction patterns to be used across journeys. Choosing libraries or native implementations for animations, gestures, and multimodal interactions. Deciding how to structure components to keep them extensible and easy to maintain. Ensuring configuration-driven UI is preferred over hardcoded logic wherever possible. Performance, Security Stability Decisions Deciding trade-offs between UI complexity and runtime performance. Implementing safe handling and rendering of user inputs, media, and AI responses. Deciding what data is rendered, masked, or excluded in the UI for compliance and audit needs. Testing UI changes across devices, OS versions, and integration environments before release
Major Challenges
Building a highly dynamic, conversational UI that replaces traditional screen-based navigation without confusing users. Delivering fluid, futuristic animations and rich visual effects while maintaining performance inside mobile WebViews and low-end devices. Handling multimodal inputs and outputs reliably across different devices, browsers, and mobile OS versions. Working within strict security, privacy, and compliance constraints while implementing advanced UI interactions. Adapting UI behavior based on user capabilities, channel limitations, and backend-driven schemas. Debugging and optimizing UI issues that span frontend code, WebView behavior, SDK integration, and backend responses. Maintaining clean, scalable frontend architecture as UI logic becomes increasingly dynamic and personalized.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Educational Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 34 years of hands-on frontend development experience. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Experience with modern frontend frameworks (Svelte, React, or equivalent). Experience building dynamic, single-page, component-based applications. Hands-on experience with animations, transitions, and motion systems. Experience handling multimodal inputs (text, voice, image, file). Familiarity with WebView constraints and cross-browser compatibility. Experience integrating with backend APIs (REST/gRPC). Performance, Security Quality Knowledge of frontend performance optimization and bundle management. Awareness of frontend security practices and safe input handling. Experience integrating analytics, audit events, and logging. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds.

title: Senior Product Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Purpose
As an AI Engineer in Data Intelligence Unit, you will help build and operate the core building blocks of Data Representation learning and Context Engineering across the credit Risk, Fraud/FRM, Sales, Collections Recovery. You will work with senior engineers and Data scientists to converts raw structured and unstructured data into reliable features, embeddings, retrieval-ready knowledge assets, and repeatable evaluation pipelines so downstream AI pods can ship models faster, safer, and with measurable quality.
Duties and Responsibilities
1) Data Representation Pipelines

Prepare and validate datasets from multiple sources (transactions, bureau, device/digital, documents,

CRM/operations)


Implement features engineering pipelines (aggregations, ratios, behavior signals) and maintain feature

definitions.


Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and

scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.


Support embedding workflows (text/customer/device/dealer/geo) including batch refresh, versioning, and

lineage.


2) Knowledge Engineering Support (Canonical Objects Metadata Assets)

Help create/maintain canonical objects, entity dictionaries, taxonomies/ontologies, and labeling guidelines.

Support annotation/labeling workflows (quality checks, consistency, sampling) for training and evaluation.


3) Experimentation Model Operations

Execute training/inference jobs using established frameworks, log experiments and outcomes.

Perform error analysis, data leakage checks, and basic model monitoring (drift signals, data anomalies)

Contribute to deployment readiness: tests, reproducible configs, and incident triage support.


4) Retrieval Context Engineering Support (LLM/RAG enablement)

Assist document processing: chunking, cleaning, metadata tagging, indexing access filters.

Maintain prompt/context templates, grounding rules, and evaluation sets for RAG/LLM assistants used by

Pods.

Run offline evaluations (retrieval quality, answer quality, regressions) and track metrics across releases.

5) Engineering Hygiene Governance

Write clean, testable code; follow Git workflows and CI checks.

Maintain documentation: dataset cards, feature notes, pipeline SOPs, and release checklists.

Follow security/privacy controls for regulated data, ensuring traceability and auditability.

Bachelors/Masters in CS/Math/Engineering

production grade ML system at scale.

Data: Pandas/PySpark basics, joins/aggregations/window functions, data validation and profiling. ML Fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, embeddings, train/val/test discipline, metrics, and error analysis. Applied System Mindset: reproducibility, structured debugging, logging/monitoring fundamentals. Good-to-have Skills ML frameworks: Pytorch / TensorFlow; experiment tracking (MLFlow) Retrieval stack: vector indexing concepts, chunking strategies, hybrid search ideas, evaluation datasets. Data/Infra: Airflow/Prefect, Spark, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MongoDB, feature stores, graph Database, vector database, model serving basics. Preferred Qualifications Experience building end-to-end decisioning platforms with real-time and batch orchestration. Graph ML / entity-resolution experience for relationship-based risk and fraud analysis. Experience operating ML systems across multiple products/segments with multi-tenant controls. Publications/patents or strong track record of innovation in applied ML, large-scale ML systems

    • Playing Scrum master role in the scrum master and performing daily stand-up and publishing the MOM and retrospection

  4. Execution Discipline
    • Ensure adherence to:
      • Agile practices
      • Delivery timelines
      • Defined scope
    • Push teams toward closure, not just discussion

Key Decisions / Dimensions

  1. Prioritization of features and backlog based on delivery feasibility and business impact
  2. Identification and escalation of delivery risks and blockers
  3. Trade-offs between:

  4. Driving go/no-go readiness from a delivery and requirement clarity perspective
  5. Selecting execution approaches to meet deadlines while maintaining quality

  • Managing delivery across multiple stakeholders, PODs, and business units simultaneously
  • Ensuring alignment between business expectations and engineering execution
  • Driving delivery in a high-speed, continuously evolving environment
  • Handling ambiguity in requirements while maintaining delivery timelines
  • Tracking dependencies across multiple systems and teams
  • Maintaining clear communication and transparency under pressure
  • Balancing speed, quality, and execution discipline

    • 36 years of experience in Business Analysis / Product / Digital domain

      • Fast-paced product organizations

      • Self-driven and proactive individual

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Kubernetes Platform & Networking
jobDescription:
Who are we

Equinix is the worlds digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform''s architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps.

This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves.

You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.

Responsibilities

OS Provisioning Bare-Metal Infrastructure

  • Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap

  • Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention

  • Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them

Kubernetes Control Plane Worker Nodes

  • Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones

  • Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node

  • Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded

CI/CD Data Plane Deployment

  • Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates

  • Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks

Network

  • Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation

  • Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over

OS Kubernetes Upgrades

  • Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change

  • Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live

  • Apply the platform''s patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Management Plane

  • Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes

  • Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free

On-Call Incident Management

  • Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events

  • Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting

  • Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate

What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months

  • Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps

  • Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion

  • Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration

  • OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks

  • etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live

  • Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane

  • Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements

Qualifications

Required

  • OS bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening

  • Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement

  • Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management

  • Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling

  • CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet

  • Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it

  • Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet

  • Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage

  • On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response

  • Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations

Preferred

  • Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance-testing pipeline around one

  • SR-IOV NIC tuning and data-plane performance validation

  • SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)

  • Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform

  • Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

Operating under the larger Enterprise Access pillar, the SIW Platform team owns Oktas secure web experiences for end-user authentication and access.   • Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity and make high-judgment technical decisions.
  • Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and influence technical direction across multiple teams.

jobDescription:
Position Overview

Vodafone Idea is looking for a seasoned AI Architect to design, build, and scale enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for defining the technical architecture and roadmap for AI applications deployed on top of our enterprise Cloudera Data Platform (CDP 7.1.9 / 7.3.1).

You will bridge the gap between complex big data ecosystems and cutting-edge machine learning/LLM workflows. The ideal candidate brings hands-on expertise in model selection, lifecycle governance, prompt engineering, and production-grade MLOps/AIOps integrated into modern DevOps pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI & CDP Solution Architecture

  • Lead the end-to-end architecture and integration of Predictive AI and Generative AI applications built directly on CDP 7.1.9 / 7.3.1 infrastructure.
  • Design high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines and feature stores leveraging CDP components (Spark, Hive, Impala, Kafka, Apache Iceberg).
  • Establish retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, fine-tuning setups, and vector search systems connected to enterprise big data repositories.

2. Model Selection, Implementation & Governance

  • Evaluate, benchmark, and select optimal foundational models (LLMs, SLMs, open-source vs. proprietary) and classic ML algorithms tailored for telecom use cases (e.g., customer churn, network optimization, hyper-personalization, fraud detection).
  • Enforce robust AI Governance frameworks covering model drift detection, explainability (XAI), fairness/bias mitigation, data privacy, and compliance.
  • Manage model registry, lifecycle versioning, and policy enforcement across dynamic runtime environments.

3. Prompt Engineering & GenAI Optimization

  • Establish standardized prompt engineering methodologies, context-window management, and agentic workflows (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).
  • Optimize token utilization, latency, throughput, and inference costs for LLM deployments.
  • Implement guardrails, output validation, and safety filters to prevent hallucination, data leakage, and security risks in public/private LLM interactions.

4. MLOps, AIOps & DevOps Integration

  • Design and implement robust MLOps/AIOps pipelines for automated model training, continuous integration, testing, deployment, and real-time monitoring (CI/CD/CT).
  • Partner with DevOps teams to deploy containerized AI microservices (Kubernetes, Docker) within hybrid-cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Configure comprehensive telemetry, logging, and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, MLflow, Weights & Biases) to maintain continuous operational health.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.

  • Big Data Platform: Deep hands-on experience with Cloudera Data Platform (CDP 7.1.9 or CDP 7.3.1), PySpark, HDFS, and Hive/Impala.
  • AI & GenAI Expertise: Proven experience developing, fine-tuning, and deploying Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG architectures, multi-agent frameworks, and traditional supervised/unsupervised ML models.
  • MLOps & Governance: Strong experience with MLflow, Model Registry, feature stores, model drift monitoring, data lineage, and enterprise AI guardrails.
  • DevOps Tools: Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), and Git workflows.
  • Programming Languages: Advanced expertise in Python, PySpark, SQL, and bash scripting.
  • Frameworks & Libraries: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Triton Server.

Preferred Qualifications

jobDescription:

title: Opening For Data and AI Engineer
jobDescription:
Description:

Main Responsibilities:
• Build end-to-end data pipelines including data collection, transformation, quality and integration solutions to facilitate Client data & analytics solutions.
• Collaborate with solution design and business requirements teams to identify data requirements and assemble large, complex data sets that meet the requirements
• Design, implement and fine-tune analytics solutions that meet business and technical requirements
• Work collaboratively with the Client data architect to ensure data model integrity
• Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources
• Create data tools for analytics and data scientist teams that assist them in building and optimising the data models and solutions
• Work with the DevOps engineer to support the consistent operation of data & analytics solutions
• Work closely with the data analysts & data scientists to design and develop APIs
• Weekly and need basis Status reporting to Client and Infosys managers
• Self-motivated, able to work independently, and attention to details
• Curious about emerging AI trends and their implications for data engineering
7 - 12 years

Academic Qualification:
• Bachelor or Masters degree in a related field (e.g. computer science, information technology, etc.)

Professional Experience
• Total experience of 7+ years in IT Industry in DWBI.
• Experience in Azure cloud platforms and technology
• Ability to define and develop data integration patterns and pipelines
• Strong knowledge of data modelling, data warehousing, and BI concepts
• Experience with Data Lake, Databricks, Data Factory, BI Dashboard, and BI implementation projects
• At least 4 years experience in SQL/PostgreSQL, data and BI solutions with integration to 3rd party tools
• Experience working with application server software (e.g. ERP), Spark, Scala, Python, SQL scripting languages, relational databases (e.g. SQL DB/DW), NoSQL platforms (e.g. HBase, MongoDB, Cassandra), cloud technologies (e.g. Azure)
• Highly experienced with processing large and complex datasets and building end-to-end data pipelines using on-premise or cloud-based data platforms
• Experienced in coding in data management, data warehousing or unstructured data environments
• Experience in the energy sector or other asset-intensive industries will be highly regarded
• Experience in using coding assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot) for uplifting productivity in development
• Familiar with GenAI concepts like RAG, orchestration frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex, vector databases etc. to collaborate efficiently with data scientists and ML engineers in AI use cases

Mandatory skills* Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Spark, Scala, Python, ADLS, Familiar with GenAI concepts

Job Title: Project Engineer – Pressure Vessel Fabrication

Experience: 5+ Years
Industry: Fabrication / EPC / Oil & Gas
Location: Berg Industries LLC
Reports to: Project Manager

Job Summary

The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting the execution of pressure vessel fabrication projects from engineering handover to final delivery. The role involves coordination between engineering, procurement, production, QA/QC, and client/third-party inspectors to ensure projects are completed within schedule, budget, and quality requirements in compliance with applicable codes and client specifications.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Execution & Coordination

  • Support Project Manager in execution of pressure vessel projects as per contract scope.
  • Review client documents such as P&ID, GA drawings, datasheets, specifications, PMS and ITP.
  • Coordinate with internal departments (Engineering, Planning, Procurement, Production, QA/QC).
  • Prepare project execution plans, schedules, and work priorities.
  • Track project progress and report status to Project Manager.

2. Engineering & Documentation

  • Review and follow up on fabrication drawings, BOM, MTO, and weld maps.
  • Assist in preparation and submission of:
    • VDRL
    • ITP
    • Welding procedures (WPS/PQR)
    • MDR / Dossier
    • Deviations and technical queries (TQ)
  • Coordinate engineering clarifications with client and third-party agencies (TPI).

3. Procurement & Material Control

  • Support procurement for material requisitions and technical evaluations.
  • Ensure materials are received as per MTC, PMI, HIC/SSC/Impact test requirements.
  • Monitor material traceability and identification during fabrication.
  • Coordinate with stores and QA/QC for material release.

4. Fabrication & Production Support

  • Monitor shop fabrication activities such as:
    • Plate rolling and forming
    • Shell & head fabrication
    • Welding, PWHT, and machining
    • Nozzle fit-up and internals
  • Resolve production issues in coordination with engineering and QA/QC.
  • Ensure adherence to approved drawings and procedures.

5. Quality & Inspection

  • Coordinate inspections with TPI / Client / Authorized Inspector (AI).
  • Ensure NDT activities (RT, UT, MT, PT) are carried out as per ITP.
  • Support hydro test, pneumatic test, dimensional inspection, and final inspection.
  • Ensure closure of NCRs and punch points.

6. Planning & Reporting

  • Prepare and update fabrication schedules and look-ahead plans.
  • Monitor milestones and highlight delays or risks.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports.
  • Support invoicing and milestone billing activities.

Required Skills & Competencies

Technical Skills

  • Good knowledge of Pressure Vessel fabrication processes.
  • Familiar with ASME Sec VIII, API 650/620.
  • Understanding of welding, NDT, PWHT, and material standards.
  • Ability to read engineering drawings and specifications.

Software Skills

  • MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint
  • Basic knowledge of Primavera / MS Project (preferred)
  • AutoCAD / Draft reading (basic)

Soft Skills

  • Strong coordination and communication skills.
  • Ability to work with multiple stakeholders.
  • Good documentation and reporting skills.
  • Problem-solving mindset.

Experience Requirements

  • 3 to 4 years experience in pressure vessel fabrication industry.
  • Experience in Oil & Gas / EPC projects preferred.
  • Exposure to client inspections (ADNOC) is an advantage.

Key Interfaces

  • Internal: Engineering, Planning, QA/QC, Procurement, Production
  • External: Client, Third Party Inspectors, Vendors, Class Authorities

Salary is not constraint for this position (Designed to attract and retain the best talent). The compensation package will compare with the best in the industry.

About the Role

The Founders Office is the strategic execution arm of the organization, working closely with the Founder and leadership team on high-priority business initiatives, growth opportunities, technology transformation, marketing, and strategic projects.


We are looking for a highly proactive, analytical, and execution-oriented professional with 13 years of experience who is eager to work closely with leadership and gain exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving business problems, identifying growth opportunities, working across functions, and turning ideas into execution. The individual will work closely with the Founder on initiatives across Business Development, Sales, Marketing, AI Transformation, Market Research, Partnerships, and Business Strategy.

The role will require strong ownership, curiosity, communication skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly.


Key Responsibilities


Business Development & Growth

  • Work closely with the Founder to identify and develop new business opportunities, partnerships, and growth initiatives.
  • Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and industry research to identify potential markets, clients, and opportunities.
  • Support lead generation, prospect research, outreach strategies, and business development activities.
  • Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, pitch decks, commercial discussions, and client-facing materials.
  • Track business development pipelines, opportunities, follow-ups, and conversion metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve revenue, customer acquisition, retention, and overall business growth.
  • Support the Founder in strategic client meetings, business discussions, and partnership conversations.

AI Transformation & Technology

  • Work with leadership to identify opportunities where AI can improve business processes, productivity, customer experience, and decision-making.
  • Research and evaluate emerging AI tools, platforms, and technologies relevant to the business.
  • Identify repetitive or manual processes that can be automated using AI and other technology solutions.
  • Support the implementation of AI-driven workflows, internal tools, dashboards, and automation initiatives.
  • Work with internal technology teams to convert business requirements into practical technology solutions.
  • Track the impact and ROI of AI and automation initiatives.

Marketing & Brand Growth

  • Work closely with leadership and the marketing team to develop and execute growth-focused marketing initiatives.
  • Support digital marketing, content strategy, campaigns, LinkedIn/social media initiatives, and other brand-building activities.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify positioning, messaging, and marketing opportunities.
  • Assist in developing marketing campaigns, presentations, case studies, sales collateral, and thought-leadership content.
  • Track marketing performance and identify opportunities to improve lead generation and brand visibility.
  • Explore new channels, partnerships, events, and initiatives that can contribute to business growth.

Strategic Projects & Founders Office Initiatives

  • Work directly with the Founder on strategic and special projects across different areas of the organization.
  • Convert high-level ideas and business objectives into actionable plans, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Independently drive assigned projects from planning through execution.
  • Coordinate with different teams to ensure timely completion of key initiatives.
  • Track project progress, identify bottlenecks, and proactively follow up with stakeholders.
  • Prepare business reviews, management presentations, reports, and decision-support materials.
  • Conduct research and analysis to support important business decisions.

Business Performance & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain business dashboards, trackers, and MIS reports.
  • Monitor key business metrics across sales, marketing, operations, and growth initiatives.
  • Analyze business performance and highlight trends, gaps, and opportunities.
  • Support leadership with data-driven insights and recommendations.
  • Use Excel, BI tools, AI tools, and other analytical platforms to improve reporting and decision-making.

Desired Candidate Profile


Educational Qualification

  • MBA / PGDM / B.Com / BBA / Economics / Engineering or equivalent qualification from a recognized institution.
  • Candidates from strong academic backgrounds with relevant business, strategy, marketing, technology, or entrepreneurial exposure will be preferred.

Experience

  • 1 - 3 years of experience in Founders Office, Business Development, Strategy, Management Consulting, Growth, Marketing, Product, Operations, or similar roles.
  • Candidates with experience working directly with founders, CXOs, or senior leadership will be preferred.
  • Experience in a startup or fast-paced business environment is an advantage.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is not limited to a single function and wants to understand how a business operates end-to-end.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable moving between a client discussion, market research, preparing a business presentation, analyzing growth data, exploring an AI solution, coordinating with internal teams, and driving a strategic initiative.

This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to the Founder and leadership team, offering the opportunity to work across Business Development, Growth, Marketing, AI Transformation, Strategy, and Business Operations.

jobDescription:
AIVAR INNOVATIONS
Senior Voice AI Engineer - Convogent Delivery
3-5 Years | Coimbatore/ Bangalore |Full-Time
About Aivar Innovations
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services and software company and an AWS Preferred Partner, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Sorin Investments. We ship production-grade AI into enterprise environments across fintech, healthcare, and technology. Our work is anchored by four accelerator platforms: Convogent (voice and agent AI automation), Velogent (governed agentic process automation for regulated industries), Kubogent (Kubernetes-native AIOps), and Datagent (data and analytics). We measure ourselves by what runs in production, not by slideware.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Senior Voice AI Engineer for Aivars Delivery organization to take voice AI use cases from discovery through live production for our enterprise customers. You will build and customize voice agents on top of Convogent - Aivars voice AI accelerator - working directly within customer engagements, delivery timelines, and SOW commitments. This is a hands-on engineering role embedded in customer-facing delivery pods, partnering closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and customer technical stakeholders to ship measurable outcomes on live calls.
What Youll Do
  • Own customer delivery outcomes. Take voice AI use cases from discovery through production go-live within committed timelines, working inside Rocketlane-tracked delivery plans alongside your Delivery Manager.
  • Customize and configure Convogent. Adapt Aivars voice AI accelerator (built on Pipecat, LiveKit) to each customers telephony stack (Twilio, Exotel, Cisco, Vonage, etc.), API/MCP integrations with customer CRM tools, knowledge base (KB) integrations, compliance constraints, and use-case requirements.
  • Engineer real-time audio pipelines for production. Optimize STT and TTS flows for the latency, concurrency, and call quality bar each customer engagement demands.
  • Troubleshoot customer production systems. When a live call does not sound right, quickly narrow down where in the pipeline it broke - capture, STT, orchestration, or TTS - by asking the right questions, reading the right signals, and driving the fix through to resolution.
  • Build and adapt the orchestration layer. Connect STT, TTS, and LLM agents into resilient, observable workflows with guardrails suited to the customers risk and compliance profile.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable solutions. Work directly with customer technical stakeholders alongside Aivars SA and DM to scope, size, and iterate use cases against measurable outcomes - success rate, latency, adoption.
  • Report and govern delivery. Contribute to sprint tracking, status reporting, and stakeholder governance for the use cases you own.
What Youll Bring
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying voice agents with Pipecat, LiveKit, or similar frameworks - ideally across multiple distinct production deployments, not a single system.
  • Deep expertise in STT (Deepgram, Whisper, AssemblyAI, Google STT, Sarvam) and TTS (ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Amazon Polly).
  • Working knowledge of Speech-to-Speech (S2S) services, including Amazon Nova Sonic, and how they change pipeline and orchestration design compared to cascaded STT/LLM/TTS.
  • Experience with multi-speaker diarization and conversation segmentation.
  • Production fluency in Python plus at least one of Node.js, TypeScript, or Go.
  • Practical use of AI/ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and conversational AI design - prompt engineering and integration with LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude, Bedrock models).
  • Cloud deployment experience on AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, EKS, Polly, Transcribe, Bedrock) with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under SOW/contract constraints - scoping, prioritizing, and shipping within a defined timeline and budget across live customer engagements.
  • Comfort working across multiple concurrent customer engagements with differing requirements, tech stacks, and stakeholders.
Preferred Experience
  • Prior experience in a customer delivery, consulting, or systems integration role, rather than purely product/platform engineering.
  • Exposure to regulated industries (fintech, healthcare, BFSI) and their compliance and security constraints.
  • Experience with enterprise stakeholder management - running status calls, translating technical tradeoffs into business language.
  • Familiarity with low-code voice platforms alongside custom infrastructure.
  • Voice analytics, transcription tooling, and Indian-language STT/TTS models.
  • AWS or speech technology certifications.

Why This Role, Why Aivar

  • Work that ships to real customers. Every use case you build runs live on enterprise calls, measured by customer outcomes, not demos.
  • Own delivery end-to-end. From discovery call to production go-live, you are the engineering owner of the customers voice AI outcome.
  • Build on accelerators that work. Convogent has real production traction - you configure and extend a working platform across diverse customer environments.
  • Direct customer exposure. Work face-to-face with enterprise technical stakeholders, not just internal teams.
  • Backed and proven. AI-native, AWS Preferred Partner, BVP- and Sorin-backed, with 100+ enterprise customers in the first year.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Kuku TV is looking for a Mid-Senior Video Editor (2-5 years) who can turn scripts, performances, live-action footage, and AI-generated visuals into high-retention, binge-worthy micro-dramas. This role is ideal for an editor who understands that great short-form storytelling is not just about cutting footage-it s about hooking viewers, building emotion, escalating conflict, and ending every episode with a reason to watch the next one.

You ll work across live-action + AI-generated content in a fast-paced, high-volume episodic production environment.

Responsibilities

Storytelling Editing

  • Edit live-action and AI-generated micro-dramas for mobile-first audiences.
  • Create powerful opening hooks, emotional peaks, reveals, twists, payoffs, and cliffhangers.
  • Shape dialogue, performances, music, SFX, voiceovers, and visuals into compelling narratives.
  • Select the strongest takes to maximise emotion, conflict, suspense, and character relationships.
  • Maintain strong pacing, visual rhythm, dialogue clarity, narrative progression, and audience retention.
  • Apply principles of information control, escalating conflict, pattern interruption, and retention-driven editing.

Mobile-First Storytelling

  • Edit specifically for vertical 9:16 formats and mobile viewing.
  • Maintain strong composition, visual hierarchy, readable performances, and screen impact.
  • Understand how to optimise storytelling for short attention spans and binge consumption.

AI Video VFX

  • Work confidently with AI-generated characters, environments, performances, and shots.
  • Identify and fix AI-video issues such as facial inconsistencies, lip-sync errors, flickering, warping, unnatural movement, frame instability, and continuity issues.
  • Handle AI-assisted post-production including lip-sync correction, cleanup, upscaling, frame interpolation, shot extension, masking, tracking, compositing, and background replacement.
  • Know when an AI shot can be fixed in post-production and when it needs to be regenerated.

Visual Sound Finishing

  • Seamlessly integrate live-action and AI footage through colour correction, grading, reframing, compositing, motion treatment, and visual matching.
  • Create titles, captions, transitions, motion graphics, VFX, recaps, end cards, and promotional elements when required.
  • Handle dialogue editing, music, ambience, Foley, and SFX to strengthen emotional and dramatic impact.
  • Ensure clear audio balance across mobile devices and viewing environments.

Production Collaboration

  • Maintain story, character, costume, location, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and performance continuity.
  • Manage multiple episodes, revisions, and priorities in a fast-moving production pipeline.
  • Collaborate with directors, writers, creative producers, AI artists, and sound designers.
  • Implement feedback accurately and meet tight delivery timelines.
  • Maintain organised project files, proxies, media libraries, naming conventions, version histories, templates, and archival masters.
  • Perform creative and technical QC and deliver final episodes to required platform, codec, resolution, frame-rate, aspect-ratio, and audio specifications.

What we re looking for

Must Have

  • 2-7 years of professional video-editing experience, preferably in fiction, micro-dramas, web series, films, TV, advertising, digital entertainment, or narrative short-form content.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, dramatic pacing, emotional editing, and technical polish.
  • Advanced Adobe Premiere Pro skills.
  • Advanced Adobe after Effects skills, including compositing, masking, and tracking, cleanup, and motion graphics.
  • Strong knowledge of Gen AI tool - Runaway, ElevanLabs, Kling, Veo, Adobe Firefly, Topaz or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of DaVinci Resolve for colour correction, grading, finishing, and media management.
  • Strong understanding of narrative structure, screen direction, continuity, performance selection, montage, shot progression, and visual rhythm.
  • Experience editing dialogue-driven scenes, romance, emotional sequences, action, confrontations, reveals, and cliffhangers.
  • Strong understanding of audience retention and mobile-first 9:16 storytelling.
  • Experience working with both live-action and AI-generated footage.
  • Strong understanding of sound editing, dialogue balancing, music placement, ambience, Foley, and SFX.
  • Ability to colour-match footage from different cameras, tools, and production pipelines.
  • Strong eye for character, facial, costume, prop, lighting, eyeline, spatial, and background continuity.
  • Ability to manage multiple episodes, revisions, and deadlines in a high-volume production environment.

AI Experience

Experience with generative AI video/image, lip-sync, cleanup, enhancement, upscaling, interpolation, shot extension, and compositing workflows is highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fluent Hindi and working proficiency in English.
  • Experience with micro-dramas, vertical dramas, episodic fiction, web series, or retention-driven entertainment.
  • Experience in fast-turnaround, high-volume episodic production.
  • Familiarity with subtitles, dubbing, localisation, and multilingual versioning.
  • Knowledge of proxy workflows, shared storage, media relinking, project templates, automated syncing, and structured post-production handoffs.

  • Film editing, filmmaking, media production, animation, or related degree/diploma is a plus, but not mandatory.

India Health Link is building a new multi-tenant Hospital Management Information System (HMIS) - one platform serving many hospitals - with Artificial Intelligence (AI) features delivered as optional plug-ins on top of a core that works fully without them. Our stack : Amazon Web Services (AWS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker, TypeScript and NestJS services, PostgreSQL 16, Python for the AI services.

What you will build
- The whole AWS footprint as Terraform code : Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), Elastic Container Service (ECS) Fargate, Relational Database Service (RDS) PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Simple Storage Service (S3), OpenSearch, Redis, EventBridge and CloudFront.
- Continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) on GitHub Actions: build, test, migrate, deploy, roll back. Deployment must be boring.
- Environments : development, staging, pre-production with anonymised data, and production.
- Monitoring and alerting that a twelve-person team can actually respond to, with centralised logs and traces.
- Backup and disaster recovery with a tested restore, not a documented one.
- The on-premise edge gateway image that runs inside a hospitals local network for analyser connectivity and Local Area Network mode when the internet is down.

Responsibilities
- Own infrastructure cost, keep it inside the agreed monthly budget, and report it monthly.
- Own security hygiene: least-privilege identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, patching, and network boundaries.
- Own remediation for the Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Test (VAPT) in month 5 - coordinate the external firm and drive every finding to closure.
- Make the developer experience good. A new engineer should be productive on day two.
- Set up data-residency arrangements appropriate to Indian health data.
- Be the person who can tell, at 2 am, whether the problem is our service, the database, or the hospitals internet connection.

Requirements
- Four or more years on AWS in production, including ECS or equivalent container orchestration, RDS, IAM and VPC networking.
- Terraform written and maintained by you, with proper modules and state management.
- Ownership of a CI/CD pipeline, including the database migration step.
- Observability in practice: you have been on call, and you have tuned alerts that were too noisy.
- Linux and networking fundamentals - you can debug why a device inside a hospital cannot reach a service.

Good to have

- On-premise or hybrid deployments, and hardware appliances in the field.

Your first 90 days
- Month 1 - all environments live, CI/CD running, the walking skeleton deployed automatically.
- Month 2 - monitoring, alerting and centralised logs in place; backups running with a tested restore.
- Month 3 - the edge gateway image built and running against analyser simulators.

How we work
Two-week sprints. Everything is code - infrastructure included. Code review on every pull request.

Billing infrastructure is revenue infrastructure. In a business running an enterprise sales-led motion and a product-led self-serve motion in parallel, the configuration quality of that stack directly determines what Finance can close cleanly, what customers are billed accurately, and how much revenue is recovered when payments fail. Were hiring a systems administrator who treats it that way.

We are seeking a Systems Administrator, Billing Systems to serve as the senior platform expert across our billing stack and a trusted operational partner to Finance, RevOps, and Product Engineering. This role will own day-to-day administration of and production support across the billing systems landscape in a scaled, dual-motion SaaS environment.

Billing Systems Administration

  • Own multiple billing platform administration for both our PLG self-serve motion and enterprise-grade invoicing and billing, including: payment methods, product and pricing catalog, subscription lifecycle, webhook monitoring, and dispute handling

  • Own dunning and revenue recovery configuration: retry schedules, smart retry settings, grace period logic, and dunning email sequences. Monitor recovery rates and optimize the sequence over time

Summary
Build AI native, HANA optimized SAP applications and extensions by combining deep ABAP on HANA engineering with agentic AI patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). The role focuses on delivering high performance, cloud ready, production-grade solutions using HANA pushdown principles, modern ABAP, and governed AI capabilities that can reason, retrieve context, and assist or act within enterprise SAP workflowswithout training foundation models from scratch.

Core Responsibilities
1) ABAP on HANA Engineering (Performance First)
Design and develop ABAP solutions optimized for SAP HANA using pushdown principles (minimize data movement, maximize in database processing).
Build efficient data models and access patterns using CDS views, associations, annotations, and authorization concepts.
Implement performance critical logic using AMDP / SQLScript where appropriate, with careful governance and testing.
2) Modern ABAP Development Clean Design
Develop modular, testable, and maintainable ABAP code aligned to clean architecture practices and enterprise SDLC.
Build services and APIs using modern paradigms (OData/service exposure patterns), ensuring stability, versioning, and contract-first behavior.
Apply secure coding standards and authorization checks consistently across data and service layers.
3) Data Modeling, Reporting Semantic Enablement
Model enterprise business entities using CDS semantics to support both transactional and analytical consumption.
Design reusable data artifacts that support downstream consumers (UI, integrations, analytics, and AI retrieval layers).
Ensure lineage-friendly structures and consistent business definitions to reduce ambiguity across systems.
4) AI Native SAP Capabilities (Agentic + Grounded)
Build AI enabled SAP experiences that integrate ABAP services with LLM capabilities, including:
oTool calling orchestration (LLM triggers approved SAP actions via controlled APIs)
oRetrieval grounded outputs (RAG style grounding) over governed SAP data and documentation
oDeterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak or confidence is low
Implement prompts/templates, tool schemas, and context assembly strategies that reduce hallucinations and enforce enterprise safety boundaries.
5) Quality Engineering Evaluation Loops (AI + ABAP)
Build automated tests (unit/integration/contract) for ABAP services and data artifacts enforce regression coverage for performance and correctness.
Establish evaluation harnesses for AI behaviors:offline golden datasets, scenario-based tests, and online monitoring to detect drift/regressions.
Introduce guardrails for AI outputs:authorization-aware context filtering, redaction rules, action confirmations, and audit logs.
6) Observability, Reliability Operations
Instrument services and critical logic with logs/metrics/traces suitable for production support and root-cause analysis.
Design robust error handling for enterprise flows:retries, idempotency, correlation IDs, and safe failure modes.
Support incident response with runbooks and structured diagnostics continuously harden solutions based on observed failure patterns.
7) Integration End to End Delivery
Integrate ABAP on HANA services with SAP and non SAP ecosystems (event-driven patterns, API gateways, enterprise integration layers).
Collaborate with UX, integration, data, and platform teams to ensure end to end solution correctness and performance.
Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
Strong hands on expertise in ABAP Development on HANA (performance tuning, pushdown, efficient SQL access patterns).
Proficiency with CDS views and modern data modeling practices (associations, annotations, authorization concepts).
Experience with AMDP / SQLScript for performance critical scenarios and controlled code pushdown.
Solid software engineering discipline:clean design, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation, and production readiness.
AI native build capability:LLM integration, retrieval grounding, tool orchestration, evaluation loops, and safety boundaries.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
OData/service design patterns, API lifecycle management, and contract-first development.
Experience integrating SAP backends with cloud runtimes and enterprise integration platforms.
Familiarity with performance benchmarking, load testing, and query-plan driven tuning practices.
Knowledge of SAP security/authorizations and compliance requirements for sensitive enterprise data.

What This Role Does Not Center On
Training or fine tuning foundation models from scratch.
AI assisted only development this role builds and owns AI behaviors (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability) as part of SAP solution delivery.

Value Delivered
High performance SAP solutions through HANA optimized ABAP engineering and disciplined pushdown design.
Faster delivery of intelligent SAP workflows via agentic AI patterns that are grounded, governed, and measurable.
Reduced operational risk through automated testing, observability, and robust safety boundaries for AI-enabled actions.
